result.summary: Found 1 major issue: the bottom navigation active-tab highlighting does not match the displayed page.

issues.description: Bottom navigation active state is inconsistent with the page content: 'Profile' is highlighted in green as the selected tab, while the screen displays the Home food-delivery feed.
issues.suggestion: Highlight 'Home' as the active bottom-navigation item on this screen and remove the green active styling from 'Profile', so the navigation state matches the displayed content.
